author: Chris Titus Tech
description:
LTT's Linux Challenge 2026 Part 2 dropped and I've got a lot to say. Luke's digging deeper into Bazzite while Linus switches to Kubuntu after an nVidia disaster — and honestly, they're getting closer to the real Linux experience than ever before.

We cover SMB vs NFS share mounting, why NTFS on Linux will always end badly, the correct way to set up Proton GE, and what it actually takes to get DaVinci Resolve running on Linux. Plus the big elephant in the room: Linux community gatekeeping.

🔗 LTT Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QK02VOGWEv0
